rebecca(auditor): Hi team, auditor request: please provide a compact evidence bundle showing your RBAC change process mapped to ISO 27001 controls plus KMS custody and rotation logs for the last 24 months. We need labeled artifacts and a short note on redaction. Can you confirm scope and ETA?

 tom(infra): Confirm scope. We'll include: - control-mapping doc (table) - RBAC PR workflow artifacts (PRs, approvals, CI runs) - rolebinding diffs + sample staged tests - KMS metadata exports (no plaintext key material) - HSM/Audit logs where applicable - emergency unwrap approvals and attestation. ETA: 48h for full bundle.

 nina(sec): Important: no plaintext key material or private key blobs in the package. Only metadata JSONs and signed attestation PDFs. We'll provide a redaction manifest that lists PII/IAM IDs redacted and a mapping file that references internal employee IDs (not full ARNs).

 josh(eng): For RBAC evidence I'll add: PR links, required-reviewers check (CODEOWNERS snapshot), and CI job log excerpt that runs a policy test. Example CI snippet I'll include:

```
# minimal ci snippet
kubectl apply -f test/rolebinding-sanity.yaml --dry-run=server
kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci-run create secrets
```

 josh(eng): Also including a sample `git diff` output and the prow/gha run id. PRs for the last 12 months that touched cluster-role/rolebinding directories will be in `rbac-prs/`.

 rebecca(auditor): For KMS please include: key policy snapshots, key rotation status, CreateDate, LastUsedDate, and any rewrap or manual decrypt/unwrap events. We need to see approver identity for manual unwraps. HSM logs if you have them.

 tom(infra): Splunk query I plan to run for KMS unwraps: `index=aws_kms action=Decrypt OR action=ReEncrypt OR action=GenerateDataKey | spath input=event detail.keyId, userIdentity.arn | table _time, userIdentity.arn, event, detail.keyId` 
 I'll export 2 variants: a CSV for auditor review and gzipped JSON for the artifact bundle.

 ops-bot: ops: evidence-export workflow triggered by @tom(infra) (run id: ev-2026-07-21-04). Expected artifacts: kms-metadata/, rbac-prs/, role-diffs/, attestations/, vuln-triage/.

 nina(sec): On HSM notes: we do not store HSM logs centrally; customer-managed EKM provides audit records in the vendor portal. I'll include screenshots and a vendor-signed export where permitted, plus a summary note about what the logs contain.

 josh(eng): Vulnerability triage: CVE-2026-0456 found in kms-helper lib. Status: patch merged (PR #4842), backlog for prod rollout (scheduled next maintenance). I'll add the triage timeline, PR link, and compensating controls (restricting the helper to subnets with limited egress until patch deploy).

 rebecca(auditor): Good. Please add a signed human attestation for any manual key material access (who, why, authorization ticket id). Also a short explanation of your emergency key access process and how you revert/rotate keys after emergency access.

 nina(sec): I'll add the emergency access SOP excerpt and a one-paragraph signed attestation (GPG) referencing ticket INCIDENT-2026-117. It will state that access was authorized, limited, and subject to rotation within 72h.

 tom(infra): Packaging details: we'll create `evidence-2026-07-21.tar.gz` with root manifest `manifest.txt` (SHA256s) and `index.csv` mapping artifacts to control IDs (e.g., ISO A.9.2.3 / SOC2 CC6). Example manifest line: `cloudtrail/kms-unwraps-2024-2026.json.gz  sha256: d2d2f03a...`

 josh(eng): For RBAC PR proof I'll include a minimal screenshot of review history (redact comments), and the `CODEOWNERS` file snapshot. Required approvers: `team-leads` + `sec-oncall` enforced by branch protection.

 ops-bot: ops: pre-package checksum generated (file: checksums.sha256, run id: ev-2026-07-21-04).

 tom(infra): Note on redaction: we'll replace full ARNs with internal ids like `user:10023` in exported JSONs and include a `redaction-map.csv` mapping those ids to display names for auditor use under NDA.

 rebecca(auditor): NDA mapping is fine. One more ask: include a brief risk note stating whether any KMS key policy changes occurred in the timeline and link to the PR/approval for each.

 nina(sec): Acknowledged. We'll include a `policy-changes/` folder with diffs and approvals.

 josh(eng): ETA update: Splunk + CloudTrail slices in ~3 hours, RBAC PR list + CI snippets in ~6 hours, full tarball in ~24-48 hours.

 rebecca(auditor): Sounds good. Please drop the presigned S3 URL here when ready. We'll begin the review and flag items. Thanks.

 nina(sec): Thanks team. I'll review the manifest before upload and sign the attestation. Ping if anything blocks.

 deploy-bot: deploy: upload completed to s3://audit-evidence/evidence-2026-07-21.tar.gz (presign exp 7 days) (uploader: tom).

 tom(infra): Presigned link: https://s3.internal/audit-evidence/evidence-2026-07-21.tar.gz?X-Amz-Signed (redacted here). Rebecca, starting review now.
